identity.name: RDP Brute Force and Lateral Movement
identity.summary: An attacker uses RDP to brute force credentials and move laterally across multiple hosts. Cortex detects abnormal RDP connections to multiple hosts as a behavioral deviation.
identity.description: An attacker uses RDP to brute force credentials and move laterally across multiple hosts. Cortex detects abnormal RDP connections to multiple hosts as a behavioral deviation.

biocs.name: Multiple RDP Connections to Different Hosts
biocs.description: Detection of multiple RDP connections to different hosts within a short time window
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip != null and dst_port = 3389
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname | filter count() > 5

abiocs.name: Abnormal RDP Connections to Multiple Hosts
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where RDP connections are made to multiple hosts in rapid succession, indicating lateral movement
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip != null and dst_port = 3389
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname | filter count() > 5
